audience: Fitbit users who want to ask questions about their own steps, sleep and heart rate

useCases.title: Summarize steps and activity over a date range
useCases.text: The AI reads the daily activity time series, for example steps for a week, and the day's summary with distance, floors, calories and active minutes.

useCases.title: Compare your sleep over several nights
useCases.text: The AI reads sleep logs for a date range, with stages, duration, efficiency and start and end times, and tells you how your nights compare.

useCases.title: Track resting heart rate and heart-rate zones
useCases.text: The AI reads heart-rate data for a date or range, with resting heart rate and time in each zone, and shows how it changes.

useCases.title: Check progress against your activity goals
useCases.text: The AI reads your daily or weekly goals and your step data, then tells you how often you reached the goal. It can also add your lifetime best stats.

useCases.title: Review food, water and weight logs for a day
useCases.text: The AI reads your food log with nutrition totals, your water intake and your weight and body fat entries for a date, so you get one daily summary.
